fields.Name: Sales: Party Lookup Promotable Contacts
fields.UserQuestion: Which people could be added as sales contacts?
fields.Description: Search for the promote dialog: people who do NOT yet have a sales contact row, whose last name, display name or email starts with the term.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Person WITHOUT a SalesContact row -- the exact complement of 'Sales: Party Lookup Contacts', differing only in EXISTS vs NOT EXISTS. Party lookup contract (bc-aidp-next-golive#372): columns ID, Name (Person.DisplayName), Detail (Person.Email); parameters Term (required) and Domain (optional; matched against Person.EmailDomain). Prefix LIKE on indexed base columns (LastName, DisplayName, Email, EmailDomain), TOP 20 ordered by DisplayName, no view and no count. Read by the sales-owned promote dialog, NOT by bizapps-party-field: that control cannot mark a row unselectable, so a promotable person must never reach a deal's contact picker (PL1).
